components.textContent:
Thousands of years of collated strategic data and hard-won combat experience have provided the Deathwatch with the ultimate battlefield tactics to combat almost any foe.

FUROR TACTICS When the enemy horde grows close, the Deathwatch will be tasked with the decimation of their core. Aiming not for clinical kills but for maximum destruction over a wide area, they tear the heart from the enemy army.

MALLEUS TACTICS When the giants of war lumber forth, the Deathwatch will adopt Malleus tactics. Even the largest behemoth has a weak point, and the archives of the Deathwatch number them all.

PURGATUS TACTICS By adopting Purgatus tactics, the Deathwatch focus their deadly ire upon the commanders of the enemy host, assassinating them one after another with pitiless head shots and killing thrusts of the blade.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly <k>Adeptus Astartes</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Masterful Tactics
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.
stratagems.effectRules:
Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: Domination Fire
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly <k>Adeptus Astartes</k> unit has shot.
stratagems.effectRules:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
  • While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

components.textContent: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.
Rarely are the Adeptus Astartes deadlier than when they bring to bear the most fundamental teachings of the Codex Astartes.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Martial Paragon
enhancements.rules:
Tacticus model only. This unit’s attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.

enhancements.name: Spearpoint War Leader
enhancements.rules: Tacticus model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

stratagems.name: Transhuman Swiftness
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.targetRules: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: Tactical Focus
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagems.effectRules: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Relentless Assault
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effectRules:
Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
  • Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

components.textContent: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.
When the Space Marines are roused to true martial fury, they bring their vengeance to their adversaries with the inescapable speed of a lightning strike.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Cyber-familiar
enhancements.rules: Tacticus model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
enhancements.rules: Tacticus model only. Friendly Adeptus Astartes units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

stratagems.name: Point-blank Brutality
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged Tacticus unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectRules:
Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have:
  • [Close-Quarters].
  • [Ignores Cover].

stratagems.name: For the Emperor!
stratagems.whenRules: Command phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Relentless Assault
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effectRules:
Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
  • Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

components.textContent: Friendly <k>Tacticus</k> units’ <k>[Rapid Fire]</k> attacks benefit from <k>[Rapid Fire]</k> when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.
Faced with multiple threats that must be efficiently eliminated, the Space Marines employ time-honoured ballistic doctrines to great effect.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Champion of the First Company
enhancements.rules: <k>Adeptus Astartes Terminator</k> model only. This unit’s melee attacks have <k>[Lethal Hits]</k>.

enhancements.name: Corporeum Reliquary
enhancements.rules: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

stratagems.name: Tactical Dreadnought Fortitude
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly <k>adeptus astartes Terminator</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Gunship Extraction
stratagems.whenRules: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Merciless Veterans
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectRules:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • [Lethal Hits].
  • [Sustained Hits 1].

components.textContent: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.
Veterans of a hundred decapitating strikes, these First Company warriors know that if they land their first blow with sufficiently furious momentum, they will need no second.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Augury Servo-host
enhancements.rules: Adeptus Astartes model only. In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18” of this unit. That enemy unit cannot have the benefit of cover.

enhancements.name: Consecrating Aura
enhancements.rules: Adeptus Astartes model only. This unit has 5+ InSv.

enhancements.name: Incendiary Animus
enhancements.rules: Chaplain/Judiciar model only. This unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.

enhancements.name: Zealous Vanguard
enhancements.rules: Adeptus Astartes model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

stratagems.name: Dread Crusaders
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: For the Emperor's Honour!
stratagems.whenRules: The Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit’s melee attacks have <k>[PRECISION]</k>.

stratagems.name: Heresy Begets Retribution
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of a friendly <k>Adeptus Astartes Infantry</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6”.

stratagems.name: Spoor of the Unholy
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly <k>Adeptus Astartes</k> unit is <b>selected to attack<b>.
stratagems.effectRules:
Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • BS and WS.
  • Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Pious Enmity
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, when a friendly Chaplain/Judiciar unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effectRules:
• Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Or: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a Monster/Vehicle unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Devout Push
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move.
stratagems.effectRules: When making that pile-in/consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3”.

components.textContent: On the eve of battle, the Black Templars gather to be led in prayer and contemplation by their champions. United in their hatred of the foe, they swear a mighty vow to uphold in the battle ahead.
components.title: Lore
